segments.note: Given distinguishes case binding from file binding; prefer[2] retains the complementary file-header level.
Prefer[0] retains direct exercise and an outcome-witnessing assertion; avoid[1] rejects tags lacking either.
Avoid[1] retains coverage-credit gaming and the resulting fictitious traceability.

activation.note: Covers existing as well as newly written per-case tags above it()/test() in the Bun realization, without filename, directory, diff, or finding prerequisites. Untagged cases and graph resolution remain excluded. Observer requirements are explicitly marked needs_new_observer rather than asserted to exist; activation elaborations are declared additions.

audit.summary: All 38 segments survive at their claimed destinations, with semantic-tagging guidance retained alongside the single URN-shape obligation. The sole waiver is source-authored, additions are declared, and the shared strict-disposition node contains only generic enforcement policy.

segmentChecks.note: The given field explicitly limits a per-case tag to ONE case rather than the file, while prefer[2] retains the complementary file-header binding.
Prefer[0] operationalizes direct exercise through the stimulus and actual assertion through an outcome witness; avoid[1] rejects tags lacking exercise and assertion.
Avoid[1] preserves both the prohibition on coverage-credit tagging and the resulting fictitious traceability.
Strict disposition remains explicit in verifier_detail[4], and the shared policy node accurately states fail-on-every-finding with no advisory mode or ratchet baseline.
The then field retains the mandatory full acc:{wagon}:{ACCEPTANCE-ID} URN and supplies both valid and invalid examples.
Verifier_detail[0] retains collection of the immediately preceding comment block for both it() and test(), validation of every tag, and the URN shape.
Verifier_detail[3], avoid[1], and evidence[1] together preserve the detector's static limit and the need for semantic review.
Prefer[1] retains the genuine-multi-acceptance condition and verifier_detail[0] explicitly allows multiple tags per line.
Unless[0] exactly preserves that untagged cases need no per-case tag and remain covered by file-header binding.
Verifier_detail[1] clearly limits this detector to shape and assigns plan/ resolution to the graph level.

risks: The coder-facing fields allow several URNs on one line but do not show the exact multi-tag syntax or whether the @covers marker must be repeated; a weak coder could choose an unsupported separator.

unobservable: file_kind requires a new Bun-test-file observer
change requires a new observer for per-case @covers blocks that exist, are added, or are edited
layer requires a new observer, although it is explicitly not a separate gate
finding requires a new observer for bun_tester_discipline_detector:malformed_covers_tag

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the shape obligation, two-level binding, semantic-truth safeguards, exceptions, and strict enforcement, so I agree with the auditor's PASS. Coder-facing guidance is sufficient for the central decision, with only a minor ambiguity about exact one-line multi-tag syntax. Activation is deterministic once the explicitly declared observers are available.
